title: clear-seen route has no direct test coverage
reasoning: The route performs a destructive delete from seen_articles and has two observable branches: 404 for a missing feed and success with cleared_count after deleting rows. The associated test file only covers listing, creating, and syncing feeds, so regressions in the clear-seen handler could ship without any failing test.
recommendation: Add focused endpoint tests that create a feed with seen_articles rows, call POST /api/feeds/{feed_id}/clear-seen, assert the rows are removed and cleared_count is correct, and assert an unknown feed_id returns 404 without deleting unrelated rows.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: tests/test_feeds.py has tests for list, create, and sync only; none call /api/feeds/{feed_id}/clear-seen or verify SeenArticle deletion behavior.
